audit.whatIsWrong: full/content level chart gave Skill at Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6, and gave Rumble the 2+ item row, contradicting the packet chart and the whys text (whys[6] explicitly flips the 1v1 to Vayne).
audit.why: Rumble out-damages Vayne every stage of lane: Flamespitter burns for 3 seconds, Scrap Shield is a 6s cooldown, and Electro Harpoon holds 2 charges of slow plus MR shred. Vayne's 52.1% comes from the two-item side-lane, not from lane.
audit.corrected: Rumble owns Level 1 through First item; Vayne takes 2+ items.
sources: kit: Rumble Q/W/E cooldowns and Danger Zone

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 text credited Final Hour with breaking his pattern; The Equalizer is the stronger 6 and Final Hour does nothing to a ground burn.
audit.why: The Equalizer is 130/105/80s and creates terrain-style zoning across the lane; Vayne has no dash except Tumble (6s at rank 1, reduced during Final Hour). Restated from the mirror audit's point 3.
audit.corrected: Rumble's 6 beats yours; your real spike is two items, and the stealth half only exists while Final Hour is running.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] said Condemn 'interrupts his positioning' without stating the decisive interaction; nothing anywhere said what Condemn does and does not do to Flamespitter.
audit.why: Flamespitter is not a channel — it burns for 3 seconds after the cast. Condemn knocks him out of the cone but the burn keeps ticking, so the trade is priced on your own exit, not on cancelling him. The threat Condemn really carries is the terrain stun.
audit.corrected: Condemn knocks him out of Flamespitter's cone but does not stop the 3-second burn; walk out with him. Its real payoff is the wall stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded that Rumble can cut Vayne's retreat with The Equalizer while she has no dash outside Tumble.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule terrain-cuts-retreat for this exact pair.
audit.corrected: Hold Flash for the wall, not for the damage.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Rumble contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Flamespitter burns for 3 seconds and out-damages your level 1 autos. Stay at max auto range and give him nothing to trade into.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Scrap Shield's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Danger-Zone Flamespitter out-damages your autos here, and Scrap Shield is only a 6s cooldown — trade on his heat, not his shield. Hold XP range.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Rumble's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Equalizer beats your level 6: it carpets your retreat, and Final Hour's stealth does nothing to a ground burn. Fight after he spends it.

edits.before: The Equalizer (R) drops a fire carpet across the lane; he can zone you off farm, cut your escape, or set up a jungle gank. Final Hour gives no protection from the burning zone.
edits.after: The Equalizer (R) drops a fire carpet that cuts your retreat — Tumble is your only out, so hold Flash for the wall, not the damage. At 130s rank 1, once he burns it the lane is walkable again.

edits.before: Now it's yours: two items of Silver Bolts true damage tear through his low health, and Condemn (E) interrupts his positioning. Dodge The Equalizer, kite in, and he can't survive your DPS.
edits.after: Now it's yours: two items of Silver Bolts true damage tear through his low health, and Condemn (E) knocks him out of Flamespitter's cone — the burn still ticks its 3 seconds, so walk out as he flies. Kite in and he dies.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It cuts your retreat and Tumble is your only out — leave sideways.

notes: Chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs, all four together as one atomic group. Packet defect note claims the chart contradicts the 52.1% win rate; it does not — Rumble owns lane and Vayne's edge is the two-item side lane, which is what the chart now says. No spell-shield/QSS/tenacity claims made: kits do not carry that data.
